pull_request.head: codex/issue117-calorimeter-digitization
pull_request.body:
## Merge scope — prototype snapshot, 2026-11-10

This PR captures the current calorimeter prototype state, its digitization implementation and the existing validation evidence. Baseline ECAL performance evaluation will start in a separate next PR from this snapshot. The retained pair-only muon width-gate failure remains part of the record; preparing this prototype for merge does not grant full stochastic qualification, detector-performance acceptance or design sign-off.

Token usage and work labels are recorded in [the accounting journal](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/bb1a50d4ac92bc8a2bfecf4d58ad63d538bb3e52/logs/codex/SESSION-2026-11-10-pr118-merge-readiness.md): 55 closed turns, 574,093,403 observed input/output tokens, assigned to eight canonical work labels. The current active readiness turn is excluded.

Refs #117. Addresses the [requested nODD geometry validation/comparison](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118#issuecomment-6744059438) on the maintained **LAYOUT-001 tracker plus complete Si–W barrel and both tiled endcaps**. The opt-in ACTS adapter reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods through a separate GPL executable; the independent reference executes Key4hep's original **DigitiserSiliconMip Gaudi algorithm**.

**Deterministic agreement passes; full stochastic validation remains incomplete.** One of four frozen replay cases fails its energy-width interval gate. The failed result is retained in the data and plot, with unchanged fixtures, seeds and criteria.

**PROTOTYPE; DES-044 remains DRAFT.** This nODD stage has no solenoid, field, HCAL, FCAL or muon system. The ODD control retains its original full geometry at zero field. DES-044 remains draft; #117 stays open for stochastic follow-up, other technologies and physical qualification.

## Original Key4hep agreement on nODD

- **Noise off:** all **22 files / 4,550 events**, **2,008,792 input cells**, **1,712,671 matched accepted cells**, and **zero missing, extra, energy or event mismatches**. All 18,734,621 contributions and original collections/MC endpoints/ordered headers are audited unchanged.
- Strict reference-only tolerance `1e-5 + 5e-6·|reference|` MIP is proven for every cell: conservative normalized upper bound **0.2000002 < 1**; independent direct maximum **0.1966895**. Cell selection matches exactly.
- **Stochastic:** four fixed 1,000-event conditional replay comparisons, from one real muon and one real endcap photon event. All mean and energy/count CDF checks pass; three energy-width interval gates pass, while **muon P fails**. P enables pairs only; PN enables pairs and electronics. Replays are not independent showers.

| Fixture, mode | Energy CDF p | Count CDF p | Energy SD-ratio 95% interval | All gates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Muon, P | 0.2698 | 0.2989 | [0.9014, 1.6698] | **FAIL** |
| Muon, PN | 0.2856 | 0.7609 | [0.9345, 1.0563] | PASS |
| γ20, η=2, P | 0.9537 | 0.0158 | [0.9678, 1.1291] | PASS |
| γ20, η=2, PN | 0.8877 | 0.0118 | [0.9141, 1.0446] | PASS |

The width gate requires the entire interval inside **[0.85, 1.15]**. Muon P has SD ratio **1.21369**, CI95 **[0.90142, 1.66978]**. Its sparse threshold shoulder has 9 original versus 15 native extra accepted pulses per 1,000 events. Independent checks identify this sensitivity in the existing draws; it does **not** establish equivalence or replace the failed gate. The interval includes unity, so the failed equivalence test alone also does not demonstrate an implementation defect. A separately specified follow-up is needed for full stochastic qualification.

![Original Key4hep and native nODD agreement, with the retained failed width gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitization-reference.png)

[Compact original/native data and provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitization-reference.json) · [Complete report and exact recipes](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-results.md)

## Geometry response and digitization changes

All **9,500 new transport events and 48 native jobs** finish normally: 7,600 e−/γ showers, 1,500 detailed muons and 400 independent ODD reference events. Persisted truth/headers, hashes and actual RNG states are checked. Raw/D/PN are paired within each geometry; the geometry samples are independent.

**nODD records 48.8–62.9% of ODD's mean raw silicon signal** at the matched points; PN ratios are 48.6–62.8%. This substantial difference already exists before digitization. The geometries differ in material, services, inactive regions and detector scope, so this comparison does **not isolate a tiling-only loss**. The report identifies the retained 3-mm nODD copper cooling plates as one concrete material difference, without assigning their individual contribution.

PN lowers the paired mean by **0.664–1.214% in nODD**, versus **0.486–0.793% in ODD**. A shared independent ODD calibration makes the geometry difference visible; there is no fitted nODD calibration. All-event SD/mean is visible-response spread, not reconstructed resolution. The η=−2 electron control is bounded to 20 GeV/c.

![Geometry response ratios and paired digitization changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-comparison.png)

![Electron raw and digitized visible response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-electron.png)

![Photon raw and digitized visible response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-photon.png)

## Digitized muons, MIP signal/noise and thresholds

Held-out 10-GeV/c muons at η=0/+2/−2 give nODD **model SNR 7.36–7.43**, with path-normalized underlying Landau MPVs 0.958/0.967/0.962 MIP. All 18 central fits and 18,000 bootstrap fits converge; full shape/boundary diagnostics apply to the central fits. SNR uses the signed model-pedestal RMS and is not a hardware measurement.

At 0.6 MIP, nODD yields **87.3–88.8% per nominal layer opportunity**, versus **about 99.6% among identified crossings**. Missing deposits leave transported-crossing status unknown; the nominal yield is not measured electronics inefficiency. ODD nominal yields are 99.70–99.77%.

Comparator settings stay fixed: 148.75 keV/MIP, strict >0.6 MIP, 2,500-MIP pre-noise range; D disables pair/noise, PN uses 3.6-eV pairs and 0.13-MIP electronics RMS.

![Digitized muon MIP, model SNR and nominal versus identified threshold yields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-mip.png)

[Compact response, histograms and covariance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-response.json) · [Exact unbinned quantiles](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-response-quantiles.json)

## Geometry checks, review and reproducibility

- Fresh native union: all ten system roots 0–9, **13,506,030 nodes and zero overlaps/extrusions at 1e-5 mm**. Actual initialized field is zero; range cuts are 0.7 mm; sensitive ECAL silicon has matched 5-mm charged-particle step limits.
- Actual cell-position audits close within 0.000196 mm, with no encoded plane collisions. ODD's physical module16 is handled with the actual readout encoder, without changing detector IDs.
- Separate PhysVal assessment reconstructs all 9,500 raw/native events, shower longitudinal sums and the 5,000-replicate shared-reference bootstrap with three 114×114 covariance matrices. It directly verifies all original/native accepted cells and all stochastic gates, including the failure. Independent deep payload coverage is stated separately from the producer's complete audit.
- **All five figures independently reproduce byte for byte.** The report preserves corrections for a missing quantile attachment, bootstrap-diagnostic wording, cache identity and table layout. The frozen statistical producer and gates remain unchanged.
- All **42 focused source/native controls and four quantile controls** pass. Inventory/project/session/interaction checks, token preview and Git-object audit pass. Hosted build, unrooted and token-site checks pass at `d68a9a52e8e102617080f6b722623f125f72268d`; current publication-head status is in the PR checks.

[Transport/native source, SDK, seed and execution provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-transport-validation.json) · [Native geometry proof](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-geometry-validation.json) · [Frozen protocol](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/5afb019eac6e152608639d02223dda73098a197f/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-protocol.md)

Raw ROOT/JSONL/replay/event/cell/trial payloads remain local and ignored. Approximate paths, sparse-hit noise, missing hardware conditions/timing/ADC/pileup and the incomplete nODD stage limit these conclusions. This PR grants no human sign-off or detector acceptance.

<details>
<summary>Earlier completed fielded ODD digitizer benchmark — separate configuration</summary>

The previous benchmark uses unchanged ODD with its full configured field. Its counts and immutable figures remain separate from the new zero-field nODD/ODD comparison above.

## Original-framework agreement

- **Noise off:** 20 real ODD files, **4,600 events**, 2,714,303 input cells and **2,357,083 matched accepted cells**. Zero missing, extra, energy-mismatch or mismatched events. Original SimHits, contributions, MC endpoints and ordered EventHeaders are retained and checked.
- The comparator uses a float tolerance of 1e-5 + 5e-6 × max(|native|, |reference|) MIP. A conservative residual-bin bound also proves the stricter reference-only formula for every cell; worst normalized upper bound **0.250001 < 1**. Threshold selection must match exactly.
- **Stochastic:** pair-only and pair-plus-electronics modes on two 1,000-event conditional replay inputs (one real muon event and one real photon event). All eight event-CDF/mean checks and four energy-width interval gates pass. ROOT and CLHEP streams are independent; repeated source events do not constitute independent showers.
- Actual seed audits caught high-bit UID changes aliasing in ROOT's effective 32-bit seed. The replay varies run and event identifiers, verifies every effective seed, and preserves all other payload. The original algorithm remains unchanged. The report retains this finding, failed technical pilots and a separate synthetic zero/threshold/saturation/empty-event control.

![Original Key4hep versus native nODD digitizer comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitization-reference.png)

[Compact reference data and exact execution provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitization-reference.json)

## Digitized muon MIP, signal/noise and threshold response

New, held-out **250 muons per direction**, η=0 and 2, with detailed contribution/particle information. The **148.75-keV/MIP calibration stays frozen** from the earlier independent sample. Comparator settings are **0.13 MIP electronics RMS**, **0.6 MIP threshold** and **3.6 eV pair energy**; these are unsigned study parameters.

| η | PN Landau-component MPV [MIP] | Numerical convolved peak [MIP] | SNR | PN layer yield at 0.6 MIP |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 0.9658 ± 0.0028 | 1.0205 ± 0.0033 | **7.422 ± 0.024** | **11965/12000 = 99.708%** |
| 2 | 0.9617 ± 0.0026 | 1.0152 ± 0.0032 | **7.391 ± 0.023** | **11964/12000 = 99.700%** |

SNR uses the fitted path-normalized Landau MPV divided by the measured **signed prethreshold pedestal RMS, 0.130119 ± 0.000206 MIP**. Both the Landau MPV and broadened numerical peak are shown, without forcing either to unity. All six fit populations completed 1,000/1,000 whole-event bootstrap fits; diagnostics and empirical modes remain in the data. Calibration/path/model systematics are separate.

The plot includes raw and digitized prethreshold spectra, **actual PN output above threshold**, signed pedestal, and the threshold scan on the same pulses. Primary-cell selection uses truth and approximate local chords, without a pulse cut. All **48 nominal layer opportunities per event** remain in the yield denominator; no missing primary layer was found here. Identified single/split crossing curves and conditional intervals are separate. Sparse split-category bootstrap errors are explicitly null when undefined; this is not full detector acceptance.

![Digitized muon MIP spectrum, SNR, signed pedestal and threshold response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/6936cc5eb7fe9eeefa27d0e8f55f48fd5f3a0a3c/docs/validation/issue117/previews/digitized-mip.png)

## Single-electron and photon response

**3,600 test showers:** e−/γ at 5, 20 and 50 GeV/c, η=0/1/2, 200 events each. Raw, deterministic D and pair-plus-electronics PN stages use the **same events**, including zeros. Three independent 100-event 20-GeV/c electron references freeze one calibration factor per η, shared across energies, species and stages. Plotted denominators use persisted generated total energy.

Top: calibrated mean-response residuals. Bottom: **all-event sample SD/mean**, with 5,000 paired whole-event/reference bootstrap errors and shared calibration covariance retained. D disables both pair statistics and electronics; PN enables both. PN−D is their combined effect.

Digitization lowers mean silicon signal by **0.495–0.847%** across these populations. The larger forward distribution tails already exist in the raw events. These are response/spread measurements, **not a Gaussian core fit or reconstructed calorimeter energy resolution**; no per-energy calibration or geometry tuning is applied.

issues.title: Calorimeter: select existing digitization models and validate a first implementation
issues.body:
## Goal
Reuse existing, validated calorimeter digitization models rather than writing our
own. Survey candidates for every calorimeter technology on `main`, then implement
and validate one end to end in the `CalorimeterDigitizationAlgorithm` skeleton.

Technologies: Si-W ECAL (DES-031), ALLEGRO-style LAr ECAL (DES-032/033),
steel/scintillator SiPM-on-tile HCAL (DES-036–038), W/quartz-fibre FCAL (DES-039).

## Starting leads (verify paths and versions)
- ATLAS Athena: `LArDigitization`, `LArROD` (OFC), `CaloTools` noise, `TileSimAlgs`
- CMS CMSSW: `HGCalSimProducers` (HGCDigitizer), HGCAL Si/scintillator noise maps,
  `HcalSimAlgos` (SiPM, HF), `SimG4CMS/Calo` (HF fibres)
- FCC-ee/Key4hep: `k4RecCalorimeter` (ALLEGRO cells, noise, calibration), HEP-FCC `dual-readout`
- ILD/CLIC: MarlinReco `DDCaloDigi`, `RealisticCaloDigiSilicon` / `RealisticCaloDigiScinPpd`
- EIC: EICrecon `CalorimeterHitDigi` (EDM4hep-native generic baseline)

ALLEGRO and ILD target low-pileup e+e−; note what each model needs for 14 TeV, μ=200
(pulse shape and out-of-time pileup for LAr, radiation-dependent noise for Si/SiPM).

## Scope
1. Survey: per technology, candidate model(s), effects covered (sampling fraction,
   Birks/photostatistics, SiPM saturation, noise, pulse shape, out-of-time pileup,
   ADC/ToA, thresholds), framework coupling and reuse effort.
2. Implement the recommended model for the **Si-W ECAL first**, using ODD's ECAL
   (same technology family) so it runs on existing ODD `ddsim` samples.
3. Validate:
   - **Unit:** noise-only events reproduce configured noise RMS and threshold rates;
     single muons give the expected MIP peak.
   - **Reference comparison:** same `ddsim` hits through the original implementation
     (e.g. Key4hep `DDCaloDigi` / `k4RecCalorimeter`) and ours agree.
   - **Physics:** single e/γ at several energies and η give sampling fraction,
     linearity and resolution consistent in scale with published Si-W results.

The EDM4hep input converter currently needs a cellID → cell-centre lookup; `ddsim`
hits already carry the cell position, so an option to use it is in scope.

The Si-W implementation is a **PROTOTYPE** until the DES is signed off.

## Done when
- [ ] DES draft recommending one model per technology, with references and open questions
- [ ] Si-W ECAL digitization implemented with unit and reference-comparison tests passing
- [ ] Single-particle response plots with recipe (binwise outputs only, per ADR-003)
- [ ] Follow-up issues listed for the remaining technologies

## Merge scope — prototype snapshot, 2026-11-10

This PR captures the current calorimeter prototype state, its digitization implementation and the existing validation evidence. Baseline ECAL performance evaluation will start in a separate next PR from this snapshot. The retained pair-only muon width-gate failure remains part of the record; preparing this prototype for merge does not grant full stochastic qualification, detector-performance acceptance or design sign-off.

Token usage and work labels are recorded in [the accounting journal](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/bb1a50d4ac92bc8a2bfecf4d58ad63d538bb3e52/logs/codex/SESSION-2026-11-10-pr118-merge-readiness.md): 55 closed turns, 574,093,403 observed input/output tokens, assigned to eight canonical work labels. The current active readiness turn is excluded.

Refs #117. Addresses the [requested nODD geometry validation/comparison](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118#issuecomment-6744059438) on the maintained **LAYOUT-001 tracker plus complete Si–W barrel and both tiled endcaps**. The opt-in ACTS adapter reuses pinned original MarlinReco energy methods through a separate GPL executable; the independent reference executes Key4hep's original **DigitiserSiliconMip Gaudi algorithm**.

**Deterministic agreement passes; full stochastic validation remains incomplete.** One of four frozen replay cases fails its energy-width interval gate. The failed result is retained in the data and plot, with unchanged fixtures, seeds and criteria.

**PROTOTYPE; DES-044 remains DRAFT.** This nODD stage has no solenoid, field, HCAL, FCAL or muon system. The ODD control retains its original full geometry at zero field. DES-044 remains draft; #117 stays open for stochastic follow-up, other technologies and physical qualification.

## Original Key4hep agreement on nODD

- **Noise off:** all **22 files / 4,550 events**, **2,008,792 input cells**, **1,712,671 matched accepted cells**, and **zero missing, extra, energy or event mismatches**. All 18,734,621 contributions and original collections/MC endpoints/ordered headers are audited unchanged.
- Strict reference-only tolerance `1e-5 + 5e-6·|reference|` MIP is proven for every cell: conservative normalized upper bound **0.2000002 < 1**; independent direct maximum **0.1966895**. Cell selection matches exactly.
- **Stochastic:** four fixed 1,000-event conditional replay comparisons, from one real muon and one real endcap photon event. All mean and energy/count CDF checks pass; three energy-width interval gates pass, while **muon P fails**. P enables pairs only; PN enables pairs and electronics. Replays are not independent showers.

| Fixture, mode | Energy CDF p | Count CDF p | Energy SD-ratio 95% interval | All gates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Muon, P | 0.2698 | 0.2989 | [0.9014, 1.6698] | **FAIL** |
| Muon, PN | 0.2856 | 0.7609 | [0.9345, 1.0563] | PASS |
| γ20, η=2, P | 0.9537 | 0.0158 | [0.9678, 1.1291] | PASS |
| γ20, η=2, PN | 0.8877 | 0.0118 | [0.9141, 1.0446] | PASS |

The width gate requires the entire interval inside **[0.85, 1.15]**. Muon P has SD ratio **1.21369**, CI95 **[0.90142, 1.66978]**. Its sparse threshold shoulder has 9 original versus 15 native extra accepted pulses per 1,000 events. Independent checks identify this sensitivity in the existing draws; it does **not** establish equivalence or replace the failed gate. The interval includes unity, so the failed equivalence test alone also does not demonstrate an implementation defect. A separately specified follow-up is needed for full stochastic qualification.

![Original Key4hep and native nODD agreement, with the retained failed width gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitization-reference.png)

[Compact original/native data and provenance](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitization-reference.json) · [Complete report and exact recipes](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/nodd-digitization-results.md)

## Geometry response and digitization changes

All **9,500 new transport events and 48 native jobs** finish normally: 7,600 e−/γ showers, 1,500 detailed muons and 400 independent ODD reference events. Persisted truth/headers, hashes and actual RNG states are checked. Raw/D/PN are paired within each geometry; the geometry samples are independent.

**nODD records 48.8–62.9% of ODD's mean raw silicon signal** at the matched points; PN ratios are 48.6–62.8%. This substantial difference already exists before digitization. The geometries differ in material, services, inactive regions and detector scope, so this comparison does **not isolate a tiling-only loss**. The report identifies the retained 3-mm nODD copper cooling plates as one concrete material difference, without assigning their individual contribution.

PN lowers the paired mean by **0.664–1.214% in nODD**, versus **0.486–0.793% in ODD**. A shared independent ODD calibration makes the geometry difference visible; there is no fitted nODD calibration. All-event SD/mean is visible-response spread, not reconstructed resolution. The η=−2 electron control is bounded to 20 GeV/c.

![Geometry response ratios and paired digitization changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-comparison.png)

![Electron raw and digitized visible response](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-electron.png)

## Digitized muons, MIP signal/noise and thresholds

Held-out 10-GeV/c muons at η=0/+2/−2 give nODD **model SNR 7.36–7.43**, with path-normalized underlying Landau MPVs 0.958/0.967/0.962 MIP. All 18 central fits and 18,000 bootstrap fits converge; full shape/boundary diagnostics apply to the central fits. SNR uses the signed model-pedestal RMS and is not a hardware measurement.

At 0.6 MIP, nODD yields **87.3–88.8% per nominal layer opportunity**, versus **about 99.6% among identified crossings**. Missing deposits leave transported-crossing status unknown; the nominal yield is not measured electronics inefficiency. ODD nominal yields are 99.70–99.77%.

Comparator settings stay fixed: 148.75 keV/MIP, strict >0.6 MIP, 2,500-MIP pre-noise range; D disables pair/noise, PN uses 3.6-eV pairs and 0.13-MIP electronics RMS.

![Digitized muon MIP, model SNR and nominal versus identified threshold yields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/eb71a9fe37c2f12e76db55dcc815e69bc8f4ce5d/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-mip.png)

## Digitized muon MIP, signal/noise and threshold response

New, held-out **250 muons per direction**, η=0 and 2, with detailed contribution/particle information. The **148.75-keV/MIP calibration stays frozen** from the earlier independent sample. | η | PN Landau-component MPV [MIP] | Numerical convolved peak [MIP] | SNR | PN layer yield at 0.6 MIP |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0 | 0.9658 ± 0.0028 | 1.0205 ± 0.0033 | **7.422 ± 0.024** | **11965/12000 = 99.708%** |
| 2 | 0.9617 ± 0.0026 | 1.0152 ± 0.0032 | **7.391 ± 0.023** | **11964/12000 = 99.700%** |

SNR uses the fitted path-normalized Landau MPV divided by the measured **signed prethreshold pedestal RMS, 0.130119 ± 0.000206 MIP**. Both the Landau MPV and broadened numerical peak are shown, without forcing either to unity. All six fit populations completed 1,000/1,000 whole-event bootstrap fits; diagnostics and empirical modes remain in the data. Calibration/path/model systematics are separate.

The plot includes raw and digitized prethreshold spectra, **actual PN output above threshold**, signed pedestal, and the threshold scan on the same pulses. Primary-cell selection uses truth and approximate local chords, without a pulse cut. All **48 nominal layer opportunities per event** remain in the yield denominator; no missing primary layer was found here. Identified single/split crossing curves and conditional intervals are separate. Sparse split-category bootstrap errors are explicitly null when undefined; this is not full detector acceptance.

Top: calibrated mean-response residuals. Bottom: **all-event sample SD/mean**, with 5,000 paired whole-event/reference bootstrap errors and shared calibration covariance retained. D disables both pair statistics and electronics; PN enables both. PN−D is their combined effect.

Digitization lowers mean silicon signal by **0.495–0.847%** across these populations. The larger forward distribution tails already exist in the raw events. **It can change the response significantly, especially near sensor boundaries—but we haven’t quantified that for nODD yet.**

There are two effects:

- **Pad segmentation alone:** changing the grid from 5.1 to 5.5 mm preserves the summed deposited energy in an ideal linear readout. Thresholds, noise and saturation can change that afterward.
- **Physical sensor tiling:** guard rings, gaps and services introduce inactive regions. These can reduce collected energy and cause position-dependent response, low-energy tails and worse resolution. Our repeated layer layout can make those losses correlated through depth.

This is an established concern: CALICE measured local response dips of approximately **14–20% near wafer gaps** in its prototype. Those numbers are **not a prediction for nODD**. Correcting the average response also does not remove the additional fluctuations. [CALICE electron-response study, §5.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0811.2354)

The current PR’s electron-response plots use **upstream ODD**, so they cannot establish the tiled detector’s performance. The new muon view only checks segmentation.

The useful next test is a **Geant4-only electron scan across tile centres, edges, corners and wedge seams**, comparing tiled silicon with a continuous-silicon control in the same nODD absorber stack. That would quantify the geometry effect without resuming the deferred Marlin study.
